title: Reconciliation run and match log
description: Per source and scope: feed receipt (source, as-of, received time, hash), match decisions with rule version, unmatched items and resulting breaks.
retention: Per sponsor record-retention policy (not yet set; SOC2-023)

title: Feed freshness status
description: Per external source, last verified balance time versus approved window, and any release blocked for staleness.

title: Tolerance and match-rule version history
description: Every policy version with author, approvers, effective date and diff from prior version; calibration evidence for new sources.

title: Break register and aging report
description: All breaks with owner, fund attribution, amount, age, status, resolution evidence and approver.

title: Post-close adjustment case file
description: For breaks found after close: original close package reference, adjustment journals, approvals and affected statements.

title: Duty conflict decision log
description: Per material action: actors in each role, conflict evaluation result and denial events.

title: Monthly reconciliation completeness certification
description: Controller-signed certification with population counts, invariant results, open breaks and sample attestation reference.
signing: Approver identity bound to certification event

title: SOC 1 Type 2 report
description: Independent service auditor report covering reconciliation and related ICFR controls.
producer: not yet assigned (no CPA firm engaged)

title: Reconciliation evidence bundle
description: Raw source files, normalized records, match decisions, rule versions and IPE metadata for a reconciliation run.
signing: Hash chain or signature (mechanism not yet chosen)

title: Replay comparison report
description: Checksum comparison of rebuilt versus issued reconciliation results.

title: Unknown-outcome case record
description: Status queries, bank evidence, resolution decision and approvers for each unknown payment or collection.

title: Migration reconciliation report
description: Source versus destination balances, units, lots and open items with differences and sign-off.
